job: Show one step the agent took, with its arguments, time and cost.
purpose: One quiet row for each tool the agent ran: the name, a summary of the arguments, duration and credits in mono. Open it to see the full arguments and the result. Consecutive calls are joined by a rail. States are queued, running, done, failed with a Retry, and approval with three choices.
useWhen: The agent calls tools and the person may want to check what ran.
A call needs permission first (approval) or has failed and can be retried.

avoidWhen.when: A plan to tick off, not exact calls.
A tool step inside a support chat; use the tool block of a chat message.

states.name: failed
states.how: data-state="failed"; danger edge, message and Retry

states.name: approval
states.how: data-state="approval"; accent wash with Allow once, Always allow, Deny

parts.role: Joins consecutive calls with a rail.
The button row that opens the panel.
A one-line summary of the arguments; hidden below 440px.
